explanation: Sixty divides evenly by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20 and 30, which made it handy for fractions. The Egyptians split day and night into 12 hours each.

claims.text: The division of the hour into 60 minutes and the minute into 60 seconds comes from the Babylonian base-60 (sexagesimal) number system.
These divisions do not come from Egyptian, Roman or Chinese counting systems.
60 is divisible without remainder by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 15, 20 and 30 (a calculation anyone can re-run).
The ancient Egyptians divided the day and the night into 12 hours each.
